summary: Installations with a private database move to the least database rights on their own, safely.

fixes.title: Least database rights, set up by itself
fixes.text: Installations with a private database now move to the least-privilege database model on their own. Broad rights are removed only after clean engine runs, and restored if a check fails.

fixes.title: Planned stops are no longer problems
fixes.text: A run that PIM Manager stops on purpose, such as during an update or a restart, is no longer reported as a problem.

fixes.title: Azure role lookups retry
fixes.text: A failed Azure role lookup gets its own error code and is retried on the next run instead of being called unrecognised.

fixes.title: Failing nightly updates are never hidden
fixes.text: Frequent update checks can no longer hide a failing nightly update, and every engine run report names the first area that failed.
